# Adjudications of the classes of disagreement between the api-json export and
# GetElementProperties (see <kind>.txt beside this file: unresolved-id, the export's id the
# RPC does not resolve; metaclass, the two sides classify the element differently; value, both
# answer, differently; exported-not-answered; answered-not-exported). Tab-separated: key, the
# side that is correct (symbol or export), the KerML/SysML clause it rests on.
export-01	export	Feature::type on a feature typed through a conjugated or chained endpoint the structure does not represent (KerML 8.3.3.3.5); the structure answers unsupported
export-02	export	KerML 8.3.2.1 Element::owningMembership of an anonymous member element; the structure answers none for it
export-03	export	KerML 8.3.2.1 Element::owningNamespace of an expression wrapper or filter condition the structure owns through no membership; the structure answers none
export-04	export	KerML 8.3.2.1 Element::owningRelationship of an anonymous member element; the structure answers none for it
export-05	export	KerML 8.3.2.4.3 Membership::visibility defaults to public on an implied membership; the structure answers private
export-06	export	KerML 8.3.2.5.1 Relationship::ownedRelatedElement of an anonymous relationship; the structure answers none for it
export-07	export	KerML 8.3.3.1.10 Type::ownedSpecialization; the structure spells a specialization the form writes as `_ss0` by position (id mapping gap)
export-08	export	KerML 8.3.3.3.8 Subsetting::subsettedFeature of an implied redefinition; the structure resolves a different library feature and needs a symbol-side check
export-09	export	KerML 8.3.3.4.2 Connector::sourceFeature of a transition succession whose source the structure does not resolve; it answers unsupported
export-10	export	KerML 8.3.3.4.2 Connector::targetFeature of a transition succession whose target the structure does not resolve; it answers unsupported
export-11	export	KerML 8.3.4.8.7 InstantiationExpression::argument of a send payload expression; the structure answers unsupported
export-12	export	KerML 8.3.4.8.x LiteralRational::value of a literal inside a feature value; the structure answers unsupported
export-13	export	Relationship::relatedElement on a typing by a conjugated port `~P` (KerML 8.3.2.5.1); the structure answers unsupported
export-14	export	Relationship::target on a typing by a conjugated port `~P` (KerML 8.3.2.5.1); the structure answers unsupported
export-15	export	Specialization::general on a typing by a conjugated port `~P` (KerML 8.3.3.1.2); the structure answers unsupported
export-16	export	SysML 8.3.12.1 ItemUsage::itemDefinition of a metadata usage is its metadata definition; the structure answers none
export-17	export	SysML 8.3.17.6 ReferenceSubsetting::referencedFeature is the chain Feature the form writes (`_pchain`); the structure has no symbol for the chain and spells a positional id
export-18	export	SysML 8.3.19.3 MetadataUsage::metadataDefinition is the metadata definition typing it; the structure answers none
export-19	export	`::>` on a reference or end is a ReferenceSubsetting (SysML 8.3.17.6 ReferenceSubsetting); the structure answers Subsetting
export-20	export	`::>` on a reference or end is a ReferenceSubsetting (SysML 8.3.17.6 ReferenceSubsetting); the structure answers Subsetting or Conjugation
export-21	export	`exhibit state` is an ExhibitStateUsage (SysML 8.3.16.9); the structure answers StateUsage
export-22	export	`expose X::*` is a NamespaceExpose (SysML 8.3.20.6); the structure answers MembershipExpose
export-23	export	`import X::*` is a NamespaceImport (KerML 8.3.2.4.9); the structure answers MembershipImport
export-24	export	`include use case` is an IncludeUseCaseUsage (SysML 8.3.26.2); the structure answers UseCaseUsage
export-25	export	`library package` is a LibraryPackage (KerML 8.3.2.6.3); the structure answers Package
export-26	export	`perform action` is a PerformActionUsage (SysML 8.3.16.12); the structure answers ActionUsage
export-27	export	a stated property of the metaclass the form writes (KerML/SysML abstract syntax); the structure answers none for it (symbol-side gap)
export-28	export	a subclassification naming `~T` is a Subclassification (KerML 8.3.3.1.4); the structure answers Conjugation
export-29	export	an action node whose body is `accept` is an AcceptActionUsage (SysML 8.3.16.2); the structure answers ActionUsage
export-30	export	an action node whose body is `assign` is an AssignmentActionUsage (SysML 8.3.16.5); the structure answers ActionUsage
export-31	export	an action node whose body is `send` is a SendActionUsage (SysML 8.3.16.13); the structure answers ActionUsage
export-32	export	an action node whose body is `terminate` is a TerminateActionUsage (SysML 8.3.16.14); the structure answers ActionUsage
export-33	export	as the conversion writes it for this anonymous usage (succession, flow or binding end, SysML 8.3.17.1 Usage::isReference/isComposite, KerML 8.3.3.3.5 Feature::isVariable); the structure derives it from the usage kind and needs a symbol-side fix

symbol-55	symbol	SysML v2 §7.6.3 (implicit [1..1] of attribute, enumeration, item, part, port, view and rendering usages; UsageParserPostProcessor): a ReferenceUsage states no implied Multiplicity, and the form writes none for any other ReferenceUsage; a trigger's declared payload parameter (SysML.xtext PayloadParameter) gets one because the form reads the rule for the recorded item usage, not the ReferenceUsage it writes (exporter follow-up)
symbol-56	symbol	KerML 8.3.3.1.10 Type::ownedFeatureMembership (the owned FeatureMemberships) and SysML 8.3.16 StateSubactionMembership (a FeatureMembership): a bare `entry;` is a StateSubactionMembership performing no action, which the form lists among ownedMembership but leaves out of ownedFeatureMembership
symbol-57	symbol	KerML 8.3.2.1 Element::owner (the owningRelationship's owningRelatedElement): a statement a subaction performs (`entry assign x := 1;`) is owned by the state through its StateSubactionMembership; the form writes the membership itself as the statement's owner (exporter follow-up)
symbol-58	symbol	SysML.xtext SourceSuccessionMember: `first a then b;` owns the two ConnectorEnds it is written with, each referring to the member it names, whether or not that name resolves (the structure reflects what is written); the form writes no end when the source resolves to nothing (exporter follow-up)
symbol-59	symbol	KerML 8.2.3.5 name resolution outward from the innermost scope, KerML 8.3.3.3.5 Feature::effectiveName (an unnamed `perform a;` bears the name of a): the first segment of `perform 'provide power'.'generate torque'` in vehicle_c1::engine_v1 is vehicle_c1's perform usage; the form resolves a head clause's chain from the outermost scope (exporter follow-up)
symbol-60	symbol	SysML 8.3.11.3 PortConjugation::conjugatedPortDefinition (the conjugated port definition owning the conjugation, redefining Conjugation::owningType) is derived; the form writes no value for it
